prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: parking lot collision in Katy, Texas. Injury: concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1163; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was backing out of a space in the parking lot of a grocery store in Katy, Texas, when my rear bumper struck the side of a pickup that was pulling through the aisle. The impact was low speed, but my head snapped forward and then back against the headrest. I felt dizzy and nauseous almost immediately, and a headache built over the next hour. I was taken to an urgent care clinic, where I was diagnosed with a concussion and advised to rest from screens and driving for several days. I have given the same description of what happened to the store staff, the responding officer, the clinic staff, and the adjuster, and I have no changes to add. I am the named driver on the policy listed on this form, and I am submitting this statement so the claim can be reviewed.
